bug_info.bug_desc: In kmac_app.sv, the localparam SelKeySize was computed from AppDigestW and then used both to select the sideloaded key length (KeyLen[SelKeySize] -> SideloadedKey) and to select the right_encode output-length constant (EncodedOutLen[SelKeySize]). Once AppDigestW was increased to 384, this made the KMAC application interface report a 384-bit sideloaded key (Key384) even though the actual sideloaded key is only 256 bits wide, corrupting key_len_o and the key encoding used for KMAC. The same conflation would also cause the output-length encoding to follow the key-size selector if SelKeySize were changed to use the key width. The fix adds AppKeyW=256, derives SelKeySize from it, and adds a separate SelDigSize derived from AppDigestW so EncodedOutLen can be indexed by the digest width.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a compile-time parameter for the application sideloaded key width (AppKeyW) and compute the key-length index from it. Compute a separate digest-width index from AppDigestW and use that index for the encoded output length, while keeping the key-length index for SideloadedKey. This decouples the two independent size selections in kmac_app.sv.
